method: Reuses accepted source furniture triangle-SAT checker against actual browser-deformed visible LOD0 meshes, including standing presenter. Seat underside metric is referenced clothing vertices inside exact top-triangle footprint, above seatTopY-65mm; not a load simulation.

support.note: Pelvis aligned to approved chair; contact pose reviewed separately.

seat_volume_probe.limits: 15mm is a review threshold, not an ergonomic or clothing-compression standard. Query samples actual used posed vertices within the top footprint and a 50mm deep slab; it does not test every point of continuous cloth volume.
